players.product: AI data-center leasing at Rockdale and Corsicana, Texas (Tier III build-to-suit on in-place utility power; AMD 50 MW, frontier AI lab 191 MW)

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: Bitcoin Mining segment revenue was $576,276 thousand in 2025 versus $321,002 thousand in 2024 and $188,996 thousand in 2023, of total revenue of $647,435 thousand (2024: $376,658 thousand); segment gross profit was $237,265 thousand versus $131,778 thousand, on mining cost of revenue of $339,011 thousand of which power $281,396 thousand. Other revenue of $6,471 thousand is primarily legacy Data Center Hosting bitcoin mining revenue. Bitcoin Mining revenue is generated through Riot's participation in a mining pool; the 10-K lists its use of third-party mining pools among its risks.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 Bitcoin Mining revenue $576,276 thousand of $647,435 thousand total; segment gross profit $237,265 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K fleet: average operating hash rate was 31.4 EH/s in 2025 versus 15.0 EH/s in 2024 (Rockdale 13.7, Corsicana 14.2, Kentucky 3.5); deployed hash rate was 38.5 EH/s at December 31, 2025 versus 31.5 EH/s (Rockdale 16.4, Corsicana 15.7, Kentucky 6.4). Combined all-in power cost was 3.7 cents per kilowatt-hour versus 3.4 (Rockdale 3.7, Corsicana 3.5, Kentucky 4.8).
quarterly_data.figure: 31.4 EH/s average operating; 38.5 EH/s deployed; 3.7 cents/kWh all-in power cost

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K mining economics: Riot mined 5,686 bitcoin in 2025 versus 4,828 in 2024, at a production value of $101,350 per bitcoin versus $66,488. Cost to mine one bitcoin excluding miner depreciation was $49,645 (49.0% of production value) versus $32,216 (48.5%), and including miner depreciation $91,427 (90.2%) versus $64,421 (96.9%). Power curtailment credits from ERCOT Demand Response Service Programs, enabled by its fixed-price power purchase contracts, were $56,729 thousand versus $33,685 thousand; bitcoin miner depreciation was $237,574 thousand versus $155,487 thousand, with miners depreciated over an estimated useful life of three years.
quarterly_data.figure: 5,686 BTC mined; cost to mine $49,645 excluding / $91,427 including miner depreciation; curtailment credits $56,729 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier MicroBT: under a long-term master purchase and sales agreement dated June 23, 2023, as amended, with MicroBT Electronics Technology Co., LTD through its manufacturing affiliate SuperAcme Technology (Hong Kong) Limited, to secure long-term supply of immersion miners all manufactured in the United States, Riot had executed purchase orders through December 31, 2025 for miners with a total hash rate of 49.2 EH/s for a total purchase price of approximately $779.5 million. Deliveries began in the fourth quarter of 2023 in monthly batches; all miners under current purchase orders are expected to be received by the second quarter of 2026, and Riot has options to purchase additional miners on the same or more favorable terms through December 31, 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 49.2 EH/s of miners ordered for approximately $779.5 million; options through December 31, 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier Bitmain: Riot currently deploys Bitmain Technologies Limited Antminer and MicroBT WhatsMiner type miners, relying primarily on immersion cooling, and a substantial portion of its fleet relies on machines from a limited number of manufacturers. The 10-K states miner manufacturers have been affected by constrained semiconductor supply, particularly shortages of the highly specialized ASIC chips used in bitcoin miners, which contributed to higher prices for new miners, and Riot expects to continue incurring elevated costs to obtain and deploy miners.

10-K: Riot states its business model is shifting toward data center development alongside bitcoin mining, and that it manages exposure to bitcoin price volatility by investing in energy-efficient miners and vertical integration and by diversifying its revenue through data center initiatives. Under its Bitcoin Treasury Strategy it selectively sells bitcoin to fund operational needs, capital expenditures and strategic initiatives: it sold 5,363 bitcoin for proceeds of $535,486 thousand in 2025 and held 18,005 bitcoin at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: 5,363 bitcoin sold for $535,486 thousand in 2025; 18,005 bitcoin held
